master_prompt.user:
Fill out train.py to 1) finetune DistilBERT on the IMDb dataset to determine whether a movie review is positive or negative and 2) save per class probabilities for test set examples to submission.csv. The dataset is available via HuggingFace's datasets library. You can find skeleton code for loading the dataset and saving prediction to subission.csv in `train.py`.

The editable component is `train.py`. Propose ONE concrete, novel idea to improve it. Conclude with two lines: 'Core idea:' and 'Non-trivial crux:'. 

IMPORTANT: Respond with ONLY the concise technical idea and a brief implementation sketch. Do NOT roleplay or adopt a persona, do NOT include a reasoning monologue or self-narration, do NOT mention any researcher by name. Output plain technical prose ending with a line "Core idea:".
